sec: 4.1 Basic Components of a Web Page
cards: 网页三大组成 / HTML, CSS, JavaScript

HTMLCSSJavaScript
Uses markups to describe the structure of the web pageDescribes the appearance/style of HTML elementsA programming language embedded in HTML that adds dynamic/interactive programs
A website is composed of a series of web pages。
Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is a standard markup language used to write web pages; it is not a programming language but a cross-platform language used to define the elements in a web page.
Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) 描述 HTML elements 的样式；one style can be applied to different pages of the website at the same time → 更易、更有效率建立及维护网站。
第五版 HTML：新增 <header>、<footer>、<section> 等；移除纯外观的 <center>、<font>、<frame>，由 CSS 取代。
Client 送 HTTP request（method: GET, path: /index.html）→ Web server 回 HTTP response（status: 200, content-type: text/html）及 HTML → browser 解读并显示。
HTML 编辑器：Text editor vs Web authoring tool

Text editor（Notepad）：所有 OS 都有；HTML code concise；免费。须懂 HTML，不能即时预览。
Web page authoring tool（Dreamweaver、Wix）：WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get)，直接预览；毋须懂 code；但 code 可能冗长。
存档：以 .html / .htm 扩展名储存，用 browser 开启。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
  <head>
    <title>My first HTML web page</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>Hello World!</h1>
  </body>
</html>
<html> = root element。<head> 包含文件资讯：<title>（显示于浏览器分页）、<script> 等。<body> = container for all visible content（只有 body 内容会显示）。

Tag：以 < > 包围，如 <p>（start tag）、</p>（end tag）。
Element：start tag + content + end tag。有些是 empty element，如 <br>、<hr>、<img>。
Attribute：写在 start tag 内提供额外资讯，name="value"，如 <img src="a.png">。

<h1>The largest title</h1>  ... <h6>smallest</h6>
<p>Paragraph 1</p>
<p>Line 1<br>Line 2</p>
<hr>
<h1>–<h6> 标题（h1 最大）；<p> 段落（前后有空行）；<br> line break；<hr> horizontal rule。HTML 会忽略原始码中的多个空格及换行，所以要用 <br>。

<!--This is a comment-->
<pre>This is
   f o r m a t t e d   text</pre>
Comment 不会显示。<pre> = preformatted text：保留空格及换行，以等宽字体显示。
文字格式标签 / Text format tags
<b> bold、<i> italic、<u> underline、<sup> superscript（如 x2）、<sub> subscript（如 H2O）。
style 属性：字体、大小、对齐

<p style="font-family:Arial">New font</p>
<p style="font-size:20px">20 pixels</p>
<p style="font-size:xx-large">...</p>
<p style="text-align:center">centre</p>
font-family、font-size（px 或 xx-small…xx-large）、text-align（left / right / center）。多个属性用 ; 分隔。

<h1 style="color:red">Red title</h1>
<p style="color:#0000FF">Blue</p>
<p style="background-color:yellow">...</p>
颜色可用名称或 hexadecimal RGB code #RRGGBB：每两位 00–FF 代表 Red、Green、Blue 强度。#FF0000 = red，#00FF00 = green，#0000FF = blue，#FFFF00 = yellow，#000000 = black，#FFFFFF = white。

<table border="1" style="border-spacing:30">
  <tr style="height:50;vertical-align:top">
    <th>Title 1</th>
    <td>row 1 cell 1</td>
  </tr>
</table>
<table> 表格；<tr> table row；<th> header cell（粗体置中）；<td> data cell。
属性：border、border-spacing（格与格之间距离）、padding（格内文字与边框距离）、height、vertical-align（top/middle/bottom）。

<td colspan="2">横跨两栏</td>
<td rowspan="3">纵跨三行</td>
colspan 合并同一行内多个 columns；rowspan 合并多个 rows。被合并的位置在后面的 <tr> 中不要再写 <td>。

<img src="orange.png" alt="orange" height="150">
src：图片路径（相对或绝对）；alt：图片无法显示时的替代文字，亦让 screen reader 读出；width / height：尺寸（只设一项会按比例）。文件名或路径错误 → 显示破图。亦可用 <audio> 与 <video> 嵌入影音。

<a href="https://www.google.com">Go to Google</a>
<a href="HTML File 2.html">Go to another page</a>
用 anchor tag <a>，href = 目的地（网址、另一页、文件）。超连结支撑整个网站的架构。图片连结：把 <img> 放在 <a> 之内。

<a name="part2">The second part</a>
<a href="#part2">Go to part 2</a>
<a href="HTML File 2.html#part2">Part 2 of another page</a>
先以 name（或 id）定义锚点；连到同页锚点时 href 值前必须加 “#”；连到另一页的锚点：文件名#名称。

<iframe src="A.html" width="500" height="500"></iframe>
Frames embed another HTML file in the current file and create a specific window (frame) to display it. 旧式 <frameset>/<frame> 已在 HTML5 移除，现用 <iframe>（inline frame）。
HTML 电邮 vs 纯文字电邮
HTML email 可套用文字格式（颜色、粗体、图片、超连结）；纯文字 email 较细、较安全。两者都可用 IMAP 接收。

建站前先规划结构与内容（如 Home、About Us、Contact Us）。
Linear：页面依次序连接（如教学步骤、故事）。
Hierarchical：由首页分支成树状（多数网站）。
Matrix（web）：页面之间互相连结，可任意跳转。
好的结构 well-organised、链接清楚 → 加强 user experience。

UI (User Interface)：graphic design and appearance — pages、buttons、icons 等视觉元素；UI designer 决定 look and feel（颜色、字体）。
UX (User Experience)：users' impression and overall experience when browsing；UX designer 研究 user needs。设计前应做 user research，按目标用户（长者、儿童）调整。
建网页前先画 wireframe 规划内容和版面，像画画先打草稿；保持简单，颜色之后再定。
网站导航 / Navigation bar & sitemap

Navigation bar：让访客快速了解资讯安排、找到所需页面（像地铁出口指示）。宜 locked at the top；选项不宜太多；按钮文字简洁、清楚、大小适中。
Sitemap：像商场的指南，lists various sections of the website in detail，帮助访客及 search engines 快速找到资讯。
适当使用 hyperlinks 亦令网站更易用。

Cross-platform design means the website can operate on different platforms, such as desktop computers and mobile devices. 多数网站 mobile 与 desktop 版用同一 URL，自动切换。
Responsive web design：内容按 screen size、platform、orientation 自动调整（resizing、重新排版）→ 各设备都好看，省去制作多个版本的时间。

The extent to which web content is easy to read and understand.
  • 用 lists and tables 代替长段落表达复杂资讯
  • 加入 multimedia elements 吸引兴趣
  • 用颜色、位置、大小、字体做对比强调重点；high colour contrast between text and background
  • 和谐的 colour scheme；避免复杂背景图片
资料输入方法 / Data input methods

除 text box 外，可用 drop-down list、slider、date picker、▲▼ buttons、radio buttons、checkboxes。
好处：users can only select from specific values → data within expectations, reducing input errors；更快、更方便（尤其触控屏）。
Date picker 例：确保日期存在（不能选 2 月 31 日）、范围合逻辑（开始早于结束）。

Makes the information on the website accessible to everyone, including people with visual impairment, hearing impairment and physical disability. 是社会责任，也吸引更多用户。
  • Font size options（调整文字大小）
  • Alternative text 让 screen readers 读出图片描述
  • High colour contrast
  • 影片字幕
  • Multi-language content（照顾少数族裔约 8% 人口）
Large font、large buttons、simple navigation bar、concise and neat structure、高对比度、可调字体大小。
Loading speed（压缩图片、bmp → jpg 减小文件）、一致的版面风格、清晰联络资料、上载前检查 broken links、版权等。

Wix is an easy-to-use drag-and-drop web design tool that provides free web hosting.
  1. Get Started → 登入/注册
  2. Create New Site → 选 template 或 Blank Template
  3. Add → 嵌入 HTML code widget（Enter Code → Apply）
  4. 拖动调位置大小；Menus and Pages 改页名
  5. Save → Publish 得到网址
免费 vs 付费网页寄存 / Web hosting
Free hosting 通常 limit storage space and browsing speed，网址带 provider 名称、可能有广告。Purchasing a hosting plan 让大量用户同时浏览、提高储存与速度，可连自订 domain name。
mc: Which describes the appearance (style) of HTML elements?
CSS 描述外观；HTML 结构；JavaScript 互动。
Which statement about HTML is correct?
Only content inside <body> is displayed in the browser window
HTML files must use the .txt extension
<title> 在 <head>；只有 body 内容显示于页面。
Which code displays H2O with 2 written lower?
Which tag creates a numbered list?
Which attribute lets a screen reader describe an image?
Which code links to an anchor named 'part2' on the same page?
A cell must span 3 rows in a table. Which attribute is used?
What is the output of <p>A   B<br>C</p> in a browser?
A   B on one line then C
A B on one line then C on the next line
A, B, C on three lines
多个空格合并为一个；<br> 换行。
Which element embeds another HTML file in a window in the current page?
A railway booking page uses a date picker instead of a text box. The main benefit is
the date entered must exist and be valid, reducing input errors
限定选择值，减少输入错误。
Which design helps visually impaired users most?
Alternative text for images and font size options
Alt text 供 screen reader；可调字体。
visitors and search engines locate information quickly
Which website structure lets every page link to any other page freely?
sq: Write HTML for a page titled 'Club' that shows a red level-1 heading 'ICT Club', a centred paragraph 'Join us!', and an image club.png 200 pixels high with alternative text 'club photo'. State where the title is displayed.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>Club</title></head>
<body>
<h1 style="color:red">ICT Club</h1>
<p style="text-align:center">Join us!</p>
<img src="club.png" alt="club photo" height="200">
</body>
</html>
Marks: correct html/head/body structure [1]; title in head [1]; h1 with color style [1]; centred p [1]; img with src, alt, height [1]. The title is displayed on the browser tab/title bar [1].
Write HTML for a 2-row table with border 1. Row 1: a header cell 'Timetable' spanning 2 columns. Row 2: cells 'Mon' and 'ICT'.

<table border="1">
  <tr><th colspan="2">Timetable</th></tr>
  <tr><td>Mon</td><td>ICT</td></tr>
</table>
Marks: table with border [1]; two tr [1]; th with colspan="2" [1]; two td in row 2 [1].

A charity designs a website for the elderly and ethnic minorities.
(a) Suggest THREE design features and explain each.
(b) Explain why the site should use responsive web design.

(a) Font size adjusting function, so users with poor eyesight can enlarge text [1]; high colour contrast / large buttons for easy reading and clicking [1]; multi-language content to reduce language barriers for ethnic minorities [1]; alt text for screen readers / simple navigation bar (any three).
(b) Users may visit with phones, tablets and computers; responsive design automatically adapts layout to screen size/orientation so it is readable on all devices [1], saving effort of building multiple versions [1].
Compare using a text editor and a web authoring tool (e.g. Wix) to build a website. Give ONE advantage of each, and ONE limitation of free web hosting.

Text editor: available in all operating systems / produces concise HTML code / full control [1]. Web authoring tool: WYSIWYG, preview directly, no need to know HTML, drag-and-drop [1]. Free hosting: limited storage space and browsing speed / URL contains provider's name / ads [1].

sec: 5.2 Effective Measures to Improve Network Security
cards: Malware refers to programs that can damage computer functions, steal user data, gain unauthorised access, or attack networks. 常见：virus、worm、Trojan program、spyware、adware、ransomware。
A virus attaches to executable files or documents. Once the user executes the program, the virus attacks files and data and self-replicates 到其他文件。需要用户执行宿主文件才会启动。

Self-replicating malware that does not need to be attached to any files and can spread through the network by itself（如经 email 发给通讯录所有人；ILOVEYOU）。因邮件来自熟人，收件人戒心低 → 迅速传播。预防：delete emails with unknown attachments、enable spam filtering、更新系统。

Disguises itself as a useful application to lure users to install it；进入系统后可建立 backdoor，让黑客 remotely control 设备、偷文件、监视网络活动。Unlike viruses and worms, it does not self-replicate. 预防：只从 official/trusted sources 下载。
Main purpose: steal the user's personal information（浏览纪录、帐户密码、甚至 keyboard input）。不同于其他 malware，spyware 不会明显破坏系统，hides to avoid being noticed；资料用来盗款或转售。
Profits from displaying advertisements as pop-up windows or banners. 有些同时是 spyware。中了 spyware/adware：大量弹出广告、首页被改、电脑变慢、出现不明 toolbar。

Encrypts the files in a computer, and the hacker demands a ransom for decryption（逾期加价或永久删除）。例：WannaCry（利用 Eternal Blue 漏洞，worm 式传播）。
中招时：不要付赎金（不保证解密）、断网、报警、由 backup 还原。预防：regular backup、update OS、firewall、antivirus。

• Dynamic web pages and client-side scripts（恶意脚本）
  • Communication software and email（附件、连结）
  • Freeware and shareware
  • Various storage devices（USB、CD）

• Unauthorised access to the system or information
  • Information locked, modified, destroyed or stolen
  • Ransom demanded to decrypt/retrieve information
  • Exhausted computer/network resources → paralysed system
  • Device remotely controlled / executing instructions issued by non-users

A hacker attack between the normal sender and receiver, intercepting or tampering with the communication between the two parties. 双方以为直接通讯，其实连线已被截取；可 tamper with transmitted content, even redirect hyperlinks to malicious websites，偷取信用卡资料。
常见手法：evil twin attack（假 Wi-Fi，无密码引人连线后监察数据）。防范：HTTPS/SSL、VPN、不用来历不明 Wi-Fi。
阻断服务攻击 / DoS & DDoS

DoS: attempts of hackers to make the target server unable to provide services to users（大量请求耗尽资源）。
DDoS (Distributed DoS)：黑客控制大量被入侵的 zombie computers（botnet），从不同地点同时攻击目标 server；zombie 主人往往不知情。

Scans the information in a computer and isolates (quarantines) infected files. 扫描时 compares files with the virus signatures in the virus database（signature = malware 的 “fingerprint”）。
须 enable automatic update 以对付最新 malware；只靠旧 signatures 无法侦测新病毒。亦应定期全机扫描。
Filters incoming and outgoing data packets according to defined rules（检查 IP address、type、port 等），block malicious packets、prevent unauthorised access，亦防止本机向外传送恶意 packets。被阻时会警告用户，用户可加例外规则。
软件防火墙 vs 硬件防火墙

Software firewallHardware firewall
Software installed on the computerPhysical device with firewall program written into the chip
Only protects a single device / isolates a single network保护整个网络；more efficient and more stable
Easier to install, lower costCost of building is high
存取控制 AAA / Access control

A network security measure used to restrict users logging in to the system.
Authentication（认证）：verifying the identity of a user — Who can access?
Authorisation（授权）：granting users access to data — What data can be accessed?（如 read only / read-write）
Accounting（帐号管理）：monitoring users' access records — What data is accessed? 确保正确使用数据。

A VPN establishes a “tunnel” between a user's device and the VPN server to transmit data. Tunnel 不是实体线，而是 tunnelling technology。用户安装 VPN app encrypts network data packets → 保护 Internet 上的数据、防 unauthorised access；ISP/黑客只看到加密流量；亦可隐藏真实 IP。

1. Intranet VPN：连接公司各分部 LANs 成为私有 intranet
  2. Remote access VPN：员工/学生在外经 VPN 存取公司/学校内部资源（network drive）
  3. Access WAN via VPN：用公共网络时加密，防黑客与 ISP 窥探

WEP (Wired Equivalent Privacy)：最旧，容易被破解。
WPA (Wi-Fi Protected Access)：用 TKIP (Temporal Key Integrity Protocol)，encrypts data with a constantly changing key。
WPA2：WPA 的进阶版，conforms to higher security standards，目前广泛使用。
安全度：WPA2 > WPA > WEP。WPA/WPA2 分 Personal（家居，共用密码）及 Enterprise（商业，每用户以帐户认证）。
SSID (Service Set Identifier) = 自订 Wi-Fi 名称。Turning off the SSID broadcast function hides the network name so that it cannot be automatically searched by other devices；需手动输入名称才能连接。
MAC 地址过滤 / MAC address filtering
The access point only allows devices with MAC addresses on the whitelist to use the Wi-Fi network，防止未授权设备连线。

As anyone can connect, hackers may intrude into public networks and monitor incoming and outgoing information；数据可能未加密、可能是 evil twin。建议：只作一般浏览，不登入网银/输入密码；用 HTTPS、VPN 或改用 mobile data；离开后 forget network。

• Disable “Pop-ups and redirects”
  • Enable automatic update of the browser → 修补 vulnerabilities
  • 只安装可信任的 plug-ins，定期检查及删除可疑插件（不断弹广告可能是恶意插件/adware）
  • 定期更新所有软件及 OS
The unauthorised interception and monitoring of the content of other people's private communications without consent（电话、IM、email、网络数据）。Difficult to detect：网络看起来一切正常。防范：加密通讯。

Hackers' behaviour of using different methods to attack and destroy network security，取得电脑/系统资讯。后果：
  • Data and files stolen or destroyed
  • Website content changed and vandalised
  • Computer becomes a zombie computer to launch DoS attacks
企业损失：客户资料外泄、声誉受损、失去客户、赔偿。

A scammer's behaviour of manipulating the trust between people or the victim's greed to trick victims into disclosing confidential personal information（信用卡、密码）；也是 spreading malware 的常见方法。类型：baiting、quid pro quo、catfishing、pretexting、phishing。

Baiting：利用好奇心，故意在公众地方留下载有 malware 的 USB/CD，有人插入电脑就自动安装。
Quid pro quo（交换）：声称提供服务/货品（如免费升级、礼物），要求受害人交出个人资料作交换，如 email 帐户和密码。

Catfishing：用他人相片与资料建立假社交帐户，编造可怜故事，常见于网上恋爱骗财。识别：拒绝视像通话/见面、不断以借口要钱。
Pretexting（假托）：pretend to be someone else to gain trust（如扮朋友要 WhatsApp verification code、扮“特工”说儿子犯法要保证金）。防范：直接致电亲友核实身份，从不透露验证码。

Scammers forge official websites and send emails/messages to deceive victims into visiting fake websites and entering personal information（如假 Hongkong Post 包裹通知）。亦有 QR code phishing。Phishing websites = 伪造网站。
识别：寄件人地址/网址拼错、紧急语气、要求输入密码或信用卡、非 HTTPS。防范：不按可疑连结，自行输入官方网址。
Sending a large number of redundant messages through SMS or emails without the recipient's consent. Spam 亦可能带诈骗或 malware。受 Unsolicited Electronic Messages Ordinance (Cap. 593) 规管。
为交朋友在公开平台展示过多 personal information（电话、地址），may lead to identity theft、cyber bullying、doxing，造成经济损失或精神压力。愈容易识别个人的资料愈敏感。
过度收集资料 / Data over-collection
Online registrations require personal information that has nothing to do with the nature of the service；资料可能被转给第三方作商业用途，甚至外泄。

To protect privacy, maintain an anonymous identity：
  • Clear browsing history and cookies
  • Turn off the autofill function
  • Use private browsing
  • Use a proxy server / VPN

A cookie is generated by a website to store information on the device to record the user's operations：偏好、购物车、login status（不用再登入）、语言设定、看过的产品。改善体验但可能侵犯私隐。
First-party cookies：当前网站产生。Third-party cookies：其他网站产生，track users across websites to personalise ads，浏览器正逐步禁止。用公共电脑后要清除 cookies 与 temporary files。
浏览器自动储存帐户名、密码、付款方式、地址，下次自动填入。在公共电脑上储存资料十分危险 → 关闭 autofill 或用 private browsing。
Does not leave browsing history, cookies and input data on the device（Incognito window）。用公共电脑时应使用。

✓ Web browsers can block the ability of web pages to use cookies to record user information（可在设定封锁 cookies / third-party cookies）。
✓ After closing all incognito (private) windows, the cookies of that session are deleted immediately.
⚠ 但 private browsing 不会隐藏 IP address：ISP、网站、network administrator 仍可记录活动；要隐藏 IP 须用 proxy server 或 VPN。

Establishes an intermediate connection point between the user and the website, hiding the user's IP address. 网站只能记录 proxy 的 IP。
与 VPN 不同：connection to the proxy server is not encrypted。
其他功能：filter web pages / block specific websites；有 buffer 作 web page caching → 再浏览同一网页时更快。

• At least 8 characters
  • 混合：at least 1 number, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase and 1 special character
  • 不要用个人资料（生日、电话）
  • 不要用太简单的（123456）或常见字（password）

• Change passwords regularly（建议至少每三个月）
  • 不要重用最近 3 个密码
  • 不要在不同系统用同一密码
  • 不要把密码写在纸上或电子设备
  • 不要发送或分享密码给他人

• Do not open attachments or hyperlinks in suspicious emails
  • 附件（特别是 .exe、.vbs、.bat）先用 antivirus 扫描
  • 启用 spam filter；不回复 spam
例：陌生邮件附件 “you.exe” 声称是相片 → 其实是可执行档（malware），不是图片。
先了解收集目的、是否必须提供、会否转交第三方；只提供必要资料；阅读 privacy policy；社交帐户设为 private。
香港相关法例 (1)：电讯条例、刑事罪行条例

Cap. 106 Telecommunications Ordinance, s.27A “Unauthorised access to computer by telecommunications”：明知而经电讯令电脑执行功能以取得未授权存取 → 罪行（罚款）。
Cap. 200 Crimes Ordinance, s.60 Destroying or damaging property：property 包括电脑内的 program/data；misuse of a computer、更改/加入/删除程式或数据都算。

sq: Distinguish virus, worm and Trojan program in terms of how they spread and whether they self-replicate.

Virus: attaches to executable files/documents and activates when the host is executed; self-replicates [1]. Worm: self-replicates and spreads through the network by itself without attaching to files (e.g. emailing all contacts) [1]. Trojan: disguises as a useful application to lure users to install it, may create a backdoor for remote control; does not self-replicate [1].

(a) Data is not encrypted / anyone can join, so hackers can intercept or monitor data (eavesdropping/MITM, evil twin) [1].

Explain how a firewall and antivirus software protect a computer, and why both should be updated/enabled.

Firewall filters incoming/outgoing data packets based on rules (IP address, port, type), blocking unauthorised access and malicious packets [2]. Antivirus scans files and compares them with virus signatures in its database, isolating infected files [2]. Automatic updates are needed so new malware signatures are recognised and vulnerabilities patched [1].
Explain the three parts of access control (AAA) using a school e-learning system as an example.

Authentication: verify the user's identity, e.g. student logs in with username and password [1]. Authorisation: grant access rights to data, e.g. students can read notes but only teachers can upload/edit marks [1]. Accounting: monitor/record users' access, e.g. log of who viewed or changed data, to ensure correct use [1].

cards:
Encryption is a process of transforming data into an unreadable form with a key. 目的：ensure data privacy in case data is hacked or accessed illegally。
Decryption is the reverse process：以对应 key 把加密数据转回原本形式。
⚠ Encryption does not prevent interception; it prevents the readable content from being interpreted.
Plaintext（明文）= 原本讯息；Ciphertext（密文）= 加密后不可读的讯息。Sender 用 encryption key 把 plaintext → ciphertext；recipient 用 decryption key 还原。Key 是一串数字和字元。例：替换表 (substitution) 把 “I love ICT” 变成 “L$oryh $LFW”。

n-bit key → 2n possible key combinations. 没有 key 的黑客要逐一尝试（brute force）。
例：16-bit = 216 = 65,536；若每秒试 2000 个，最多需 65536/2000 ≈ 32.8 秒。256-bit = 2256 ≈ 1.16×1077。
Longer key → more combinations → more time needed to crack → more secure，但加解密运算时间较长。
私钥加密 / Symmetric (private key) encryption

Uses the same key for both encryption and decryption. Key 须预先交换并保密，双方用同一 key。
问题：how to transfer the key securely；用户多时 key management becomes difficult（每对用户一把 key）。优点：运算快。
公钥加密 / Asymmetric (public key) encryption
每位用户有一对 keys：public key（公开给所有人）与 private key（保密，只有自己持有）。They work in pairs and are unique for each user. A message encrypted with one key must be decrypted by the other key of the pair.
Sender encrypts with the recipient's public key → only the designated recipient can decrypt with their own private key. 任何人都可加密给收件人。适合 online banking 及保密传输（如老师把成绩发给每位学生，只有该生能读）。
公钥加密：Authentication mode（数码签署）
Sender encrypts (signs) with their own private key → anyone can decrypt with the sender's public key, verifying the identity of the sender. 这是 digital signature 的基础（如学校发通告，证明确由学校发出）。

• 中学把认证过的 ECA 纪录发给大学（要证明来源）→ secondary school's private key
  • 问卷要保密地发给机构 → organisation's public key
  • 学生把信用卡资料发给商户 → merchant's public key
  • 家长数码签署回条 → parent's private key
口诀：保密用收件人公钥；证明身份用寄件人私钥。
公开密码匙基础建设 / PKI 与 CA

PKI is a network security architecture based on public key encryption，依靠公认的 Certification Authorities (CA)。CA acts as a publicly trusted third party to issue and manage digital certificates. Digital certificate = 与 public key 连结的数码文件，verifies the identity of the key owner，解决“公钥是否伪造”的问题。申请人须提供身份证明文件。
香港的 CA 与 ETO

Hongkong Post 是 Electronic Transactions Ordinance (ETO, Cap. 553) 下首个 recognised CA，发出 e-Cert、Bank-Cert、iAM Smart-Cert；另一个是 Digi-Sign。根据 ETO，以 recognised digital certificate 支援的 digital signature 与手写签名有同等法律地位。

Sender 用收件人公钥加密并用自己私钥签署；recipient 用寄件人公钥验证并用自己私钥解密。
  1. Privacy：只有指定收件人能解密
  2. Authentication：能以公钥验证 → 证明由 key owner 签署
  3. Integrity：签署后若被修改就无法验证 → 证明未被第三方改动
  4. Non-repudiation：authentication + integrity 的结果，sender cannot deny having sent the message

Authentication in access control is a measure used to verify the user's identity；只有 authorised users 能登入。方法：username & password、token、smart card、biometrics、digital certificate、two-factor authentication。
用户名与密码 / Username and password
最常见、convenient；安全度取决于 password strength。有些系统用 security questions 代替密码。缺点：可被猜中、偷看、phishing。

A token is a security device used to authenticate a user, like an electronic key.
Hard token：小型电子认证硬件（如银行 security device）。
Soft token：安装在电脑/手机的软件，内有加密储存于 keystore 的 private key。
Token 易遗失 → 常需先输入 password 启动，之后产生 one-time password (OTP)。

Each OTP can only be used once and becomes invalid after a short time → protects against password guessing attacks（和被偷看后重用）。
误解：OTP 是由 token 在本机产生的，不是从 server 传入 token。
Must be physically connected to the device（USB、NFC、Bluetooth），连接后自动传送认证资料。
A type of hard token. Its chip stores encrypted information or the private key of the card holder. 例：新智能身份证、Octopus card（电子支付及学校门禁）。

Identifies a person by unique physical attributes：
  • Fingerprint：手指真皮纹路
  • Retina scan：视网膜血管图案
  • Iris scan：虹膜纹路
  • Facial recognition：眼距、鼻等特征
  • Voice recognition：vocal tract shape
  • Signature recognition（behavioural）：笔的倾斜、压力、时间
Pros：不用记、不会遗失、难伪造。

✗ “Voice recognition” is the same as “Speech recognition”.
✓ Voice recognition 用于 biometric authentication（认出是谁说话）；Speech recognition 把说话内容转成文字/指令（认出说了什么）。
Biometric data is extremely sensitive: once leaked, it cannot be “reset” like a password. 提供前要考虑是否真的必要。Data user 只应收集达到原本目的所需最少资料，并只用于单一目的（如身份认证）。
数码证书认证 / iAM Smart
Recognised digital certificate issued by a recognised CA confirms identity（Hongkong Post CA、Digi-Sign）。iAM Smart（智方便）2020 年推出：一站式登入政府/商业网上服务、自动填表、digital signing。

Combined use of two (different) authentication factors to verify identity，如 something you know（password）+ something you hold（mobile phone/token）。黑客可经 Internet 偷密码，但很难经 Internet 偷走 something you hold → 更安全。例：手机通知确认、SMS 验证码、authenticator app。

✗ Dual password authentication is a 2FA.
✓ Two passwords are the same factor (something you know), so it is NOT 2FA. 2FA 必须是两种不同类别的因素。

用 HTTP 传送机密资料（plain text）不安全。SSL (Secure Sockets Layer, known as TLS) establishes an authenticated and encrypted communication link between clients and servers using public key encryption. 网页以 SSL 加密并用 HTTPS 传送 → 可安全传送信用卡号码及登入资料。浏览器显示 lock icon。

✗ HTTPS is used to secure data, including data in the database.
✓ SSL only applies during the data transmission process. 数据到达 server 储存后的安全要靠其他措施。
登入网银前，click the “lock” icon to check the digital (SSL) certificate：确认网站身份（由 CA 签发、属于该银行、未过期）→ 防 phishing 网站。SSL certificate enables an encrypted connection（但不能防病毒）。

✗ Digital signature is also called electronic signature.
✓ A digital signature is different from, and is NOT, an electronic signature. Electronic signature 泛指任何电子形式的签署（如扫描手写签名、在平板签名）；digital signature 是用 private key + digital certificate (PKI) 产生，可验证身份与完整性。

高风险交易（如转账给新收款人）须 2FA。用户以 username/password 登入后，要完整使用服务需输入 security token 产生的 OTP。
Token 亦提供 transaction signing：输入交易资料（如收款户口号码）产生对应 security code，作额外验证。Smart card 结合银行卡与 security token。
网上交易的 2FA：SMS OTP 与 QR code

Mobile SMS OTP：银行把 OTP 以 SMS 发到已登记手机；只可用一次、短时间内失效。SIM card 的唯一性令手机可作 security token，毋须另带装置；同一号码可用于多个系统。
QR code：桌面付款页显示 QR code，用手机 digital wallet 扫描确认。
安全习惯：用 wired 而非 public wireless、强密码并定期更换、只扫可信 QR code（检查有否贴上假贴纸）。

三个基本认证因素：
  • Something you KNOW：password、PIN、security questions
  • Something you HOLD：token、smart card、mobile phone
  • Something you ARE：fingerprint、facial scan、voiceprint
The greater the number of factors verified, the higher the degree of authentication. 两个 = 2FA；三个 = three-factor。
AI 在网络安全的应用

AI collects and analyses users' login patterns（地点、时间、IP、设备）。发现异常 → 要求更强认证：
同地、正常时间、见过 IP → 直接登入；国内不同地区 → 2FA；不同国家、不寻常时间、从未见过的 IP → advanced MFA。
Behavioural biometrics：分析鼠标移动、打字速度与模式 → 减少登入麻烦，同时降低 credentials 被盗风险。

Virtual currencies such as Bitcoin use a decentralised peer-to-peer payment network without banks or central authorities. 每位用户有 distributed ledger，记录网络上所有交易。Miners 验证交易有效性并获 bitcoin 奖励（Bitcoin mining）。

1. Peter 要给 Daisy 1 bitcoin
  2. Peter signs the transaction with his own private key
  3. Miners collect and validate transactions into a block
  4. Block 发布到网络，every distributed ledger is updated
  5. Daisy 收到 1 bitcoin
纪录公开、cannot be tampered with or deleted。
A type of emerging virtual asset（digital artworks、in-game items）。每个 NFT 含独特资讯（creator、creation date），像“身份证”；ownership and transactions are verified through blockchains，纪录公开且不可篡改 → 证明拥有权。

sq: Compare symmetric and asymmetric key encryption. State ONE problem of symmetric encryption and how asymmetric encryption solves it.

Symmetric: same (private) key used for encryption and decryption [1]. Asymmetric: a key pair; message encrypted with one key can only be decrypted by the other key of the pair; public key is shared, private key kept secret [1]. Problem: the shared key must be transferred securely / key management difficult with many users [1]. Asymmetric: anyone can encrypt with the recipient's public key and only the recipient's private key can decrypt, so no secret key needs to be exchanged [1].

A school sends exam results to each student and also posts an official notice to all students.
(a) Which key should the school use to encrypt each student's results? Explain.
(b) Which key should the school use for the notice? Explain.

(a) The student's public key [1]; only that student can decrypt it with his own private key, ensuring privacy [1].
(b) The school's private key [1]; anyone can decrypt with the school's public key, proving the notice comes from the school (authentication/digital signature) [1].
Explain the FOUR purposes of PKI (privacy, authentication, integrity, non-repudiation) and the role of a CA.

Privacy: encrypted with the recipient's public key so only the recipient can decrypt [1]. Authentication: message signed with sender's private key; verifying with sender's public key proves the sender [1]. Integrity: if modified after signing, verification with the public key fails [1]. Non-repudiation: sender cannot deny sending as only he holds the private key [1]. CA: trusted third party that verifies identity and issues/manages digital certificates binding a public key to its owner [1].

An online bank uses username/password plus an SMS OTP.
(a) Explain why this is two-factor authentication.
(b) Why is it more secure than password alone?
(c) Explain why the user should check the lock icon before logging in.

(a) Combines something you know (password) and something you hold (registered mobile phone receiving the OTP) [1].
(b) Even if hackers steal the password over the Internet, they are unlikely to hold the phone; OTP is single-use and expires quickly [1].
(c) The lock shows SSL/HTTPS encryption of transmitted data [1] and lets the user view the digital certificate to confirm the site is the genuine bank, not a phishing site [1].
Describe how blockchain enables Bitcoin transactions without a bank, and state ONE use of blockchain besides currency.

Decentralised P2P network; each user keeps a distributed ledger of all transactions [1]. Sender signs the transaction with his private key [1]; miners validate transactions and group them into a block, which is published and added to every ledger [1]; records are public and cannot be tampered with or deleted [1]. Other use: NFTs to prove ownership of digital assets [1].
